top.title: Gold, Silver Gains Likely Limited by Fed in ‘Inflation-Fighting Mode’
top.summary: Spot gold rose and Julius Baer said short-term price gains in gold and silver will likely be limited as long as the Federal Reserve “remains in inflation-fighting mode.”

top.title: HANetf Launches First Euro-Hedged Bitcoin Fund
top.summary: While Bitcoin is a digital currency, it is typically priced in U.S. dollars, raising risk for investors seeking to diversify away from the greenback.

top.title: Crude Oil Lower As Saudi Arabia Resumes Red Sea Oil Exports
